filmCast.units: Kodak CC; 100 CC = 1.0 filter optical density
filmCast.baseline: Reference film neutral filters on the same paper (fixed lab pack)
notes: Experimental Film Lab variant, not an upstream spektrafilm preset.
The cast direction comes from the calibrated filter database; it is not tuned to a remembered film colour.
The amount is solved per film and paper so 18% gray reaches a CIELAB chroma target; the targets are an editorial choice, not a measured lab recipe.
Films listed in TARGET_HUE (Fujifilm C200) use an editorial cast hue instead of the database direction; the hue is a chosen look, not a measurement.
Cast strength is matched only at mid-gray; the cast direction still differs by film and paper, including pink/magenta casts.
Mid-gray print exposure normalization stays on, so brightness is aligned but colour is not neutralized.

processingPath: film exposure -> film development -> print exposure through a blended fixed-pack filter -> print development -> print scan

limitations: Standard clipping and gamut compression cannot be inverted exactly; clipped highlights and colours cannot be restored.
Use the exact camera model and unadjusted Standard Photo Style. No automatic exposure or image statistics are applied.
Camera cube interpolation is undocumented; tetrahedral and trilinear rebake error are both reported.
Native V-Log acquisition gain, noise and highlight headroom cannot be recreated by an output LUT.
Matched controlled capture validation is pending for this camera model.

stdReferenceDescription: Serialized camera-specific Standard-to-V-Log adapter (trilinear) followed by the unchanged serialized creative VLOG cube (tetrahedral). stdVsDirectEngine is a compatibility key for this sequential transform; it measures 33-grid rebaking error, not a continuous engine or camera accuracy.
gamutPolicy: Unchanged source VLOG output gamut mapping and clipping; no added output correction.
preview: Selected camera Standard pixels -> selected merged STD cube once, tetrahedral interpolation.
